<!--
Three-week due-date calendar (revealjs only), e.g. for an Announcements slide.

Usage: include _extensions/paytonej/ucinci/resources/partials/three-week-calendar.qmd after the announcement bullets
(the shortcode is not written out here because Quarto expands it inside comments).
Needs the Jupyter engine with openpyxl. Re-render after changing the workbook.

Settings (optional), in an earlier code cell:
  cal3_workbook = "schedule.xlsx"   the workbook below (this is the default)
  cal3_date = "2026-11-16"          the class day to center on; otherwise the
                                    workbook's Schedule is searched, then today
  cal3_groups = {...}               Assignment Group -> exam / project / homework /
                                    anticipation (the color of the item)

The workbook has three sheets; the first row of each holds the column names.
  Schedule:    Date, Meeting Number, Meeting Filename Prefix
               A row with a Meeting Number is a class day. The lecture is the row
               whose prefix matches the first four characters of the .qmd name.
  Assignments: Assignment Title, Assignment Group, Due Date, Due Time ("09:30:00")
  Key Dates:   weekday, date, description. Rows starting "Last day to" are shown
               as deadlines. Rows after a "Holidays, Breaks, and Conflicts" row
               are days off.
The window starts on the Monday of the lecture's week.
-->

::: {.content-visible when-format="revealjs"}

```{=html}
<style>
.cal3 { font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.15; margin-top: .4em; }
.cal3-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
.cal3-head { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: #333333; }
.cal3-day {
  background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #e0dfe3; border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 5px 8px; min-height: 142px; box-sizing: border-box;
}
.cal3-day.off { background: #f3f3f3; }
.cal3-day.current { border: 4px solid #000000; padding: 3px 6px; }
.cal3-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: .85em; color: #333333; }
.cal3-top b { color: #000000; }
.cal3-off-label { font-size: .85em; font-style: italic; color: #333333; }
.cal3-item { border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 7px; margin-top: 4px; }
.cal3-item small { display: block; font-size: .78em; }
.cal3-exam { background: #e00122; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; }
.cal3-project { background: #333333; color: #ffffff; }
.cal3-homework { background: #f3f3f3; color: #000000; border-left: 8px solid #e00122; }
.cal3-anticipation { background: #f3f3f3; color: #000000; border-left: 8px solid #d1b179; }
.cal3-admin { background: #ffffff; color: #000000; border: 2px dashed #333333; }
.cal3-next { font-size: .9em; margin-top: .4em; color: #333333; }
</style>
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
import datetime as _dt
import html as _html
import os as _os
from openpyxl import load_workbook as _load_workbook


def _cal3_time(t):
    return f"{t.hour % 12 or 12}:{t.minute:02d} {'am' if t.hour < 12 else 'pm'}"


def _cal3_label(title):
    title = title.split(" - ")[0].replace("Term Project ", "Project ")
    return title.replace(" Problem Set", "").replace("Questions", "Qs")


def _cal3_render():
    wb = _load_workbook(globals().get("cal3_workbook", "schedule.xlsx"),
                        data_only=True, read_only=True)

    def as_records(sheet):
        rows = [r for r in wb[sheet].iter_rows(values_only=True) if any(c is not None for c in r)]
        return [dict(zip(rows[0], r)) for r in rows[1:]]

    def as_date(value):
        return value.date() if isinstance(value, _dt.datetime) else None

    # Which lecture is this? Falls back to today for anything not on the schedule.
    prefix = _os.environ.get("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE", "")[:4]
    schedule = as_records("Schedule")
    lecture = next((as_date(r["Date"]) for r in schedule
                    if r["Meeting Filename Prefix"] == prefix), None) or _dt.date.today()
    if globals().get("cal3_date"):
        lecture = _dt.date.fromisoformat(str(globals()["cal3_date"])[:10])
    monday = lecture - _dt.timedelta(days=lecture.weekday())
    window_end = monday + _dt.timedelta(days=20)

    class_days = {as_date(r["Date"]) for r in schedule if r["Meeting Number"]}

    # Key Dates has two stacked lists: term dates, then holidays and conflicts.
    off_days, items, in_holidays = {}, {}, False
    for weekday, day, description, *_ in wb["Key Dates"].iter_rows(values_only=True):
        if weekday == "Holidays, Breaks, and Conflicts":
            in_holidays = True
        day = as_date(day)
        if day is None or not description:
            continue
        if in_holidays:
            off_days[day] = description.replace("Veteran's", "Veterans")
        elif description.startswith("Last day to"):
            items.setdefault(day, []).append((_dt.time(0), "admin", description, ""))

    group_kind = globals().get("cal3_groups") or {
        "Exams": "exam", "Term Project": "project",
        "Homework Problem Sets": "homework",
        "Exam Anticipation Questions": "anticipation"}
    rows = [r for r in wb["Assignments"].iter_rows(values_only=True) if any(c is not None for c in r)]
    upcoming = []
    for r in (dict(zip(rows[0], row)) for row in rows[1:]):
        day, kind = as_date(r["Due Date"]), group_kind.get(r["Assignment Group"])
        if day is None or kind is None:
            continue
        label = _cal3_label(r["Assignment Title"])
        # The workbook stores due times as "09:30:00" text; exams have none.
        due = _dt.time.fromisoformat(r["Due Time"]) if r["Due Time"] else _dt.time(0)
        when = "in class" if kind == "exam" else f"due {_cal3_time(due)}"
        items.setdefault(day, []).append((due, kind, label, when))
        if day > window_end:
            upcoming.append((day, label))

    out = ['<div class="cal3"><div class="cal3-grid">']
    out += [f'<div class="cal3-head">{d}</div>' for d in ("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri")]
    for offset in (o for o in range(21) if o % 7 < 5):
        day = monday + _dt.timedelta(days=offset)
        classes = "cal3-day" + (" off" if day in off_days else "") + (" current" if day == lecture else "")
        day_items = sorted(items.get(day, []))
        is_exam = any(kind == "exam" for _, kind, _, _ in day_items)
        tag = "class" if day in class_days and not is_exam else ""
        out.append(f'<div class="{classes}"><div class="cal3-top">'
                   f'<b>{day:%b} {day.day}</b><span>{tag}</span></div>')
        if day in off_days:
            out.append(f'<div class="cal3-off-label">{_html.escape(off_days[day])}</div>')
        for _, kind, label, when in day_items:
            note = f"<small>{when}</small>" if when else ""
            out.append(f'<div class="cal3-item cal3-{kind}">{_html.escape(label)}{note}</div>')
        out.append("</div>")
    out.append("</div>")

    if upcoming:
        following = " · ".join(f"<b>{d:%b} {d.day}</b> {_html.escape(l)}" for d, l in sorted(upcoming)[:3])
        out.append(f'<div class="cal3-next">After this: {following}</div>')
    out.append("</div>")

    print("```{=html}\n" + "\n".join(out) + "\n```")


_cal3_render()
```
